substantive_deltas.claim: v0.2 is retained only as a synthetic five-regime classifier; its 0/1600 negative-control result is not a general false-positive bound.
Trusted external quality outperformed sample count at matched coverage but failed the absolute 5-percent and zero-false-promotion gates under cross-channel leakage.
Current BASE frontend coverage is insufficiently evidenced for the real FRANK source: V6 regresses a canonical G9 form, and real FRANK uses use/fn/let/require/return outside V5 top-level forms.
Ignition-like transitions can be concentrated at readout commit; this is a live counterhypothesis to treating ignition alone as workspace evidence.
WASI 0.3 is a stable specification while current Wasmtime p3 documentation still labels the implementation experimental, incomplete, unstable and not production-ready.

hypotheses.claim: A multidimensional externally measured quality vector predicts held-out emergence-meter reliability better than log sample count, with topology interactions.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Quality is merely a correlated proxy and topology alone explains reliability.
hypotheses.test: Fit quality-only, log-n-only, topology-only and interaction models on preregistered blocks; compare selective risk and false promotions at matched coverage.

hypotheses.claim: Independent confirmation plus valid sequential inference and random audits of screened negatives is noninferior to exhaustive testing.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Screening preferentially removes the rare counterexamples.
hypotheses.test: Prospective cross-fit screen, independent confirm set, e-values or alpha spending, random negative audits.

hypotheses.claim: Structured corruptions have identifiable held-out failure fingerprints.
hypotheses.test: Fresh-seed structured corruption cube with held-out topology identification and UNKNOWN on estimator disagreement.

hypotheses.claim: The four-axis CIC vector predicts OOD flexible routing better than any scalar component.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Readout commit explains the whole signature without a workspace.
hypotheses.test: Forked futures crossed with route competition, lesion/rescue and truthful/shuffled/broken provenance reentry.

hypotheses.claim: Route-specific receiver lesion harms flexible use and route-specific rescue restores it.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Generic context or redundant receiver paths cause rescue.
hypotheses.test: Equal-information and equal-cost sham rescue, receiver map and co-lesions.

hypotheses.claim: Truth-bound provenance reentry improves future use more than payload-matched shuffled or broken reentry.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Reentry helps only through added tokens, gain or salience.
hypotheses.test: Match payload, length, timing and gain; mutate only provenance binding.

hypotheses.claim: Frozen generic G9 semantics are sufficient to realize H1 ActiveAssembly without FRANK-specific syntax.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: At least one required behavior cannot be represented generically.
hypotheses.test: H1/H2 differential over packet identity, epoch, deterministic selection, conflicts, ancestry, reexpansion, hash and authority non-minting.

hypotheses.claim: An explicit versioned dialect/pre-lowering bridge closes the real FRANK frontend gap with less regression surface than BASE syntax widening.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Direct grammar extension is smaller and more deterministic.
hypotheses.test: Prototype both routes and compare exact roundtrip, semantic identity, type/effect compatibility, authority closure and regression surface.

hypotheses.claim: WITWorld plus host grants, effect policy and gateway receipts provides effective least authority; WITWorld alone does not.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Typed interface worlds are sufficient in practice.
hypotheses.test: Run identical WIT worlds under two grants and attempt unauthorized path, network and receipt writes.

hypotheses.claim: Degree-sensitive switching among incremental, lazy and rebuild lowers p99 on mixed topologies.
hypotheses.test: Component and power-law graphs crossed with leaf, hub and delete updates; compare parity, CPU, memory, p99 and write amplification.

hypotheses.claim: Projection frontiers plus a consistency predicate prevent mixed cross-store reads better than a global epoch name.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: One atomic global epoch is enough.
hypotheses.test: Delay, duplicate, reorder and crash between event DB, graph, index and authority projections.

new_concepts.definition: Estimator multiverse whose disagreement yields UNKNOWN rather than majority promotion.
Evidence weight is invariant under clones of one root and grows only with independent root measurements.
Graph stores only opaque attenuated references and policy metadata; real capabilities remain in the gateway.
Certificate over event sequence, canonical version, projection frontiers and authority version.
Hub updates advance a generation; dependents lazily validate at read frontier.
Provenance reentry must pass an external challenge before it can influence strong workspace evidence.
Workspace is a causal route across receivers rather than a fixed location.
Each cognitive decision consumes a certified local causal cut with explicit unknown frontiers.
Valid boot permutations may create different stable policies despite identical final inputs; test through permutation and reversible reinitialization.

preserved_negative_results: Original v0.2 robustness script exits before the sweep because assess() rejects permutation_draws.
Clock-drift construction up to 20 percent caused no mutation-attributable categorical error or false promotion; this is not a safety proof.
Receiver-selective missingness caused 6 of 960 errors and no false promotion while nominal sample count stayed unchanged.
Common-driver controls produced zero false promotions under the tested leakage severities.
The post-hoc leakage tripwire is not validated and cannot be promoted.
Stable WASI specification does not imply production-ready Wasmtime p3 implementation.
Runner labels and owner-local machine fingerprints are not hardware attestation.
Incremental parity does not establish favorable hub-update scaling.
Atomic local reservation does not establish exactly-once external effects.

routing.impulse: Use held-out leakage results, preserve v0.2 invalidation and API break, require independent episode units, null ensemble, cross-fit macro selection and origin-plus-fidelity gates; do not duplicate the 1600-run matrix.
Prioritize forked-future x lesion/rescue x provenance-reentry test and treat readout commit as explicit counterhypothesis.
Run exact Ubuntu frontend discriminator, implement generic ActiveAssembly substrate first, keep WASI p3 experimental and do not count labels as attestation.
Benchmark dependency tricolor, hub firebreaks, projection-frontier cuts and per-object CAS against global-token designs.
